newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine T-bill yields unchanged 3-mths, up 6-12.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine T-bill yields unchanged 3-mths, up 6-12.

text.p: Average yields at auctions of three-month treasury bills were unchanged, and yields on six-month and 12-month bills rose from the last sales, the central bank said on Friday.
Auctions of nine-month bills were cancelled without explanation. The next auction of nine-month bills is scheduled for April 14.
Three-month bills remained at 24.47 percent, six-month bills rose to 31.30 percent from 31.14 percent, and 12-month bills firmed to 39.89 percent from 39.79 percent.
The results of Friday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 4.00 million UAH 5.00 million UAH
Amount sold 3.02 million UAH 3.55 million UAH
Actual amount raised 2.85 million UAH 3.35 million UAH
The central bank sold 30,203 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 14.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 7.00 million UAH 8.00 million UAH
Amount sold 4.06 million UAH 4.11 million UAH
Actual amount raised 3.51 million UAH 3.56 million UAH
The central bank sold 40,642 T-bills, the bank said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 14.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 20.00 million UAH 25.00 million UAH
Amount sold 8.63 million UAH 18.66 million UAH
Actual amount raised 6.17 million UAH 13.36 million UAH
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 14.
